resources.string: Please crop the image to include only the prescription (Rx) or medication section before submitting.
Images may be processed by an external AI service. Tap for privacy details.

CleaRx may send your prescription image or extracted information to an external AI service to read handwriting and prepare results. Images can contain personal or health information. Share only images you are allowed to use.\n\nExternal processing uses an encrypted provider connection. This does not guarantee that a local connection from your phone to the backend is encrypted. Images and records may remain stored after this session. Automatic deletion and masking are not implemented, and provider retention or training guarantees have not been verified.
CleaRx is a prescription reader and decision aid, not a verifier. Compare every extracted field against the original prescription. CleaRx does not make dispensing decisions.
Prescription reader and decision aid, not a verifier. Compare all fields with the original. CleaRx does not make dispensing decisions.
Fields marked ⚠ Double-check or ✖ Verify, and unmatched names, need closer comparison with the original. Confidence labels describe recognition or matching, not medication safety.
Compare flagged or unmatched fields with the original. Confidence is not a safety rating.
No detected field warnings: compare with the photo
How to read the confidence labels

These labels summarize detected field warnings. They are not a verified accuracy percentage or a check that a medicine is right or safe.

No detected warnings means the available checks found no field warnings; errors can still be present. Compare every medicine and instruction with the photo.

Double-check means a field is unclear, incomplete, or conflicts with the catalog.

Verify means CleaRx could not resolve the medicine name reliably. Confirm against the original prescription or the prescriber.

Name similarity measures spelling agreement only. OCR confidence may be unavailable. Missing fields show Not found.
